profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that trades on NASDAQ under the ticker EH. On its own site the company describes itself as an autonomous aerial vehicle, or AAV, technology platform company and as a leading one in that field, with a stated mission of making safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. It says it supplies AAV products and commercial solutions to customers across industries, naming urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management and aerial media as its main areas.

The site also lists passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media and infrastructure solutions among its offerings, and presents itself as a forerunner of AAV technologies and commercial solutions in the global urban air mobility industry. Its SEC central index key is 0001759783, and it is also recorded under the alias EHANG HOLDINGS LTD-SPS ADR.

No litigation, tracked products or other registry entries appear in the available material.
